leads.name: Drago de Igueste de Candelaria
leads.reason: Confirmed to exist and to carry municipal protection status (listed on tenerife.es's own arboles-monumentales portal and mentioned by candelaria.es for the Igueste district), but no age, height or girth figure found this pass, and no second independent source beyond the Cabildo listing. candelaria.es itself failed to fetch (self-signed certificate error). Worth a second pass with a direct visit to candelaria.es via browser or a search of local Tenerife press.

leads.name: El Almacigo (Pistacia atlantica singular specimen), El Sauzal
leads.reason: tenerife.es's own arboles-monumentales portal names 'El Almacigo, El Sauzal' as a designated monumental tree, but no page giving its specific age, height or exact address was found this pass; general species background (can exceed 1000 years) was found but not tied to this specimen. A different, better documented Almacigo exists in Arona (9m tall) per a general search, not the same tree.
